title: Add a stairs-and-boxes terrain task for the original hexapod environment
summary: A new task, Hexapod-Rough-v21-Direct-v0, trains the original hexapod environment blind over a 10-level course of rough ground, slopes, stairs up, pits and boxes, with a terrain curriculum, a swing-clearance reward and an optional command-speed curriculum. The original Flat and Rough tasks are unchanged.
next: Train Hexapod-Rough-v21-Direct-v0 natively on the Spark from a flat BC + PPO checkpoint and compare it under the common evaluator.
reason: An opt-in training task beside the original hexapod tasks; it changes no admitted model, gate, roadmap marker or the omniwalk runtime, and records no native result in this repository.
